    return _h__b

def _h_orders_in(dh, start, end):

    return dh[dh['valid'] & (dh['dt'] >= s) & (dh['dt'] < e)]

def _h_order_rev(ct, dh, start, end):
    ids = set(_h_orders_in(dh, start, end)['Số phiếu'])
    return ct[ct['Số CT'].isin(ids)].groupby('Số CT')['rev'].sum()

def _h_revenue(ct, dh, start, end):
    return float(_h_order_rev(ct, dh, start, end).sum())

from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
import pandas as pd

t = _h_tables()

def rank_rev(rank, a, b):
    s, e = pd.Timestamp(a), pd.Timestamp(b) + pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    ids = set(dh[dh['valid'] & (dh['dt'] >= s) & (dh['dt'] < e)
                 & (dh['cust_rank'] == _h_norm(rank))]['Số phiếu'])
    return float(ct[ct['Số CT'].isin(ids)]['rev'].sum())


def debt_at(asof):

    paid = tt[tt['dt'] <= a].groupby('Mã giao dịch')['amount'].sum()

    d['out'] = d['total'] - d['paid_calc']
    return d[d['out'] > 0]

    d['paid'] = d['MaHoaDon'].map(paid).fillna(0)
